maddeler.e:
يستشهدان (form X)
# يَسْتَشْهِدَانِ (yastašhidāni) /jas.taʃ.hi.daː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada)
# يُسْتَشْهَدَانِ (yustašhadāni) /jus.taʃ.ha.daː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada) and اُسْتُشْهِدَ (ustušhida)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
